//: The RUNTIME config for `pnpm accept`, used only by `tsx --tsconfig`. tsc never
It exists because tsconfig.json next to it cannot do both jobs. tsx resolves a
file's compilerOptions by matching it against the tsconfig's `include`; the
sibling tsconfig.json includes only `src/**/*.ts`, so app files compiled during
a run match nothing and fall back to esbuild's defaults — which means the
CLASSIC JSX transform, and `React is not defined` the moment a clause renders an
email template. Widening the sibling's `include` instead would drag app .tsx
into the acceptance package's own `tsc --noEmit`, which has no DOM lib.
So: same paths, same jsx, but an `include` that covers everything a clause can
